exposure: SCHs with premature rupture of membranes (PROM)
SCHs with hypertensive disorder complicating pregnancy (HDCP)
Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs vaginal delivery)
finding: While the coexistence of SCHs with HDCP, IVF, or PROM did not significantly increase the risk of premature birth, it was associated with a higher rate of cesarean section.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean sections for patients with subchorionic hematomas and gestational diabetes mellitus, hypertensive disorder complicating pregnancy, or in vitro fertilization was significantly higher than that for vaginal deliveries.
